proposalManagerCalendar.title: Proposal Meetings & Calendar
proposalManagerCalendar.subtitle: Deadlines, team activity, kickoffs, and reviews — one operational calendar for your pursuit team.
proposalManagerCalendar.emptyHint: No events yet. Upload RFPs in Source Docs (for deadlines), use Team Collab (for assignments), or click Add event for kickoffs and reviews.
proposalManagerCalendar.noEventsThisMonth: {{count}} event(s) exist in other months — the calendar jumped to the nearest activity. Use list view or the arrows to browse.

rfpCollaboration.pmLoginHintFallback: If you are not logged in as Proposal Manager in JUNO, or auto-connect failed, sign in with the collaboration PM account (e.g. jordan@juno / pm123).
rfpCollaboration.pmOnlyPortal: This portal is for Proposal Managers only. Auditors should use /collaboration.
rfpCollaboration.auditorOnlyPortal: This portal is for Auditors only. Proposal Managers should use the hub under Proposal Manager.

rfpCollaboration.rfpDocumentPlaceholder: Paste key sections of the RFP for context…
rfpCollaboration.splitWithAi: Split document into requirements with AI
rfpCollaboration.workspaceMissingTitle: This collaboration workspace is not on the server
rfpCollaboration.workspaceMissingBody: That usually happens after a backend restart (workspaces used to live only in memory). Workspaces are now saved to disk so restarts keep them. For this link: open your RFP in Source Docs, then use “Ask to audit” again — a new workspace link will be created. You can also clear the old link from the proposal workspace if it still fails.
rfpCollaboration.usePmPortal: Use the Proposal Manager collaboration hub:
rfpCollaboration.activityLogLive: Updates in real time when the backend pushes events.
rfpCollaboration.quarterlyAuditorHint: Mark each focus area for this workspace. The Proposal Manager can see statuses here.
rfpCollaboration.auditorPortalSubtitle: Answer assigned RFP questions with AI assistance.
rfpCollaboration.auditorLoginHint: Use your auditor account (e.g. aiyana@juno / aud123).
rfpCollaboration.auditorMainLoginHint: Or sign in on the main JUNO login with usernames aiyana_yazzie, chayton_bitsui, talise_nez, or kiona_tsosie (password aud123) for the same tools plus the standard app sidebar.
rfpCollaboration.noAssignments: No questions assigned yet. Your Proposal Manager will assign items from a workspace.
rfpCollaboration.askPmPlaceholder: Ask the Proposal Manager a clarification…

proposalManagerWorkspace.title: Workspace
proposalManagerWorkspace.subtitle: Upload RFP documents, choose a document type, and scan to extract Q&As and facts for use in Content Hub and proposals.
proposalManagerWorkspace.maxSizeNote: Max {{maxMb}} MB. Document is scanned on upload (OCR used for scanned/image PDFs); Q&As and facts are stored for Content Hub.
proposalManagerWorkspace.noDocuments: No documents in this folder. Upload a file above.

rfpWorkspace.title: RFP response workspace
rfpWorkspace.subtitle: Pick a scanned document, answer each extracted question, and track completion. Answers are saved with the document in this browser.
rfpWorkspace.emptyNoSelection: Upload and scan a file in the section above, then pick it here to work through extracted requirements.
rfpWorkspace.emptyNoQuestions: No readable requirements were found in this text. Try Rescan or another file.
rfpWorkspace.pickQuestion: Select a question on the left to view or edit your response.
rfpWorkspace.answerPlaceholder: Type your proposal response, or use Generate with AI.
rfpWorkspace.aiSplitHint: Uses your scanned document text to produce a clean, numbered list of separate requirements (replaces the current list and saved answers for this document).
rfpWorkspace.aiSplitEmpty: The model returned no items. Try again or use Rescan.
rfpWorkspace.aiSplitFailed: Could not split requirements with AI. Check that the API is running and try again.
rfpWorkspace.documentTemplatePickerHint: Preview layouts below—each is an AI section map, not your final export.
rfpWorkspace.documentTemplateAiHint: Each template places your workspace answers into professional sections using AI (requires OPENAI_API_KEY on the server). The Word file ends with an Annex of raw Q&A for verification.
rfpWorkspace.generateDocumentHint: Answer at least one question to enable document generation.
rfpWorkspace.generateDocumentModalSubtitle: Pick how you want Word output. The structured option uses the layout you chose above plus AI on the server.
rfpWorkspace.generateModalStructuredDescription: Builds professional sections from your answers using the template you picked ({{template}}), then adds a Q&A annex. Requires OpenAI on the server.

documentTemplates.standardIndustryDescription: Nine sections—executive summary, company, technical, team, plan, risk, compliance, pricing, references.
documentTemplates.federalStyleDescription: Government-style blocks—transmittal, understanding, technical, management, past performance, QA, subcontracting, cost.
documentTemplates.leanCommercialDescription: Four short sections—executive summary, solution, delivery plan, commercial summary.

rfpWorkspace.generateDocumentNoAnswers: No answered questions found. Please answer at least one question.
rfpWorkspace.generateDocumentFailed: Failed to generate document. Please try again.
rfpWorkspace.auditCollabRequired: Team Collab could not connect. Ensure you are logged in as Proposal Manager and the collaboration API is running.
rfpWorkspace.auditCollabMapFailed: Could not link workspace questions to this list. Try again or split requirements again.
rfpWorkspace.auditLinkStale: This document’s questions changed after Team Collab was linked. Unlink to assign auditors to the current list.
rfpWorkspace.collabStaleLinkCleared: The saved collaboration link no longer exists on the server (for example after a deploy). It was cleared from this document — use “Ask to audit” again to create a fresh workspace.
rfpWorkspace.insertAuditorResponse: Append auditor’s answer to my response
rfpWorkspace.auditDraftInProgress: The auditor has a draft in progress.
rfpWorkspace.auditWaitingAuditor: Waiting for the auditor to submit their answer.
rfpWorkspace.auditModalSubtitle: The selected team member will see this requirement on their dashboard. When they submit, you can pull their answer into your response below.
rfpWorkspace.extractStructuredHint: Runs on this document’s scanned text (backend). If Team Collab is linked, results are also stored under that workspace for later API retrieval.
rfpWorkspace.structuredNoTables: No tables detected in the extracted text.
rfpWorkspace.exportModalSubtitle: Choose how you want your answers exported to Word.
rfpWorkspace.exportOptionSimpleDescription: A clean Word file with each requirement and your response—fast and easy to review.
rfpWorkspace.exportOptionStyledDescription: Uses the Marln technical proposal to DXC Word template on the server. AI maps your answers into the right paragraphs while preserving styles and structure as much as possible.

proposalManagerWinSlide.title: Win Slide
proposalManagerWinSlide.subtitle: After RFP selection: a POV + proof/testing template that names who we won against — or lost against — for orals, debrief, and product review.
proposalManagerWinSlide.exportError: Could not generate the win-slide deck. Is juno-backend running?
proposalManagerWinSlide.againstHint: Pick the peer field from Competitive Intelligence (max 4).

proposalManagerScoring.title: Win / Loss Scoring
proposalManagerScoring.subtitle: Ingest Section M and debrief scores, see why we won or lost, and turn capability gaps into a roadmap Product Engineering can ship.
proposalManagerScoring.empty: Select a pursuit to review scores and gaps.
proposalManagerScoring.summaryPlaceholder: Debrief summary — why this outcome happened
proposalManagerScoring.ingestHint: Paste rows: Factor | Section M | Weight % | Our score | Winner score | Max. Example: Technical Approach | M.1 | 40 | 3.2 | 3.8 | 5
proposalManagerScoring.ingestError: No factors parsed. Use | or tab-separated rows with a name and numeric scores.
proposalManagerScoring.gapsHint: Each gap is a candidate backlog item for Product Engineering — mapped to a JUNO product area.
proposalManagerScoring.gapDescription: Why it cost us / how it would change the score
proposalManagerScoring.roadmapHint: Unique gaps across pursuits, ranked by severity and how often they appeared on losses.

proposalManagerTopology.title: Environment Topology
proposalManagerTopology.subtitle: Customer as-is infrastructure with the icon legend for this RFP class — then overlay JUNO capabilities where they sit in the buyer’s environment without replacing systems of record.
proposalManagerTopology.linkedIssuer: Linked issuer: {{name}} ({{sector}}). Template is suggested from Company Intelligence.
proposalManagerTopology.noIssuer: No issuer linked. Pick an environment class, or load a company in Company Intelligence to tailor names.
proposalManagerTopology.placementsTitle: How JUNO product features sit in their environment

proposalManagerCompetitiveIntelligence.title: Competitive Intelligence
proposalManagerCompetitiveIntelligence.subtitle: Select peer competitors and datasheet metrics to compare positioning, then review each firm’s value proposition and key differentiators for your pursuit.
proposalManagerCompetitiveIntelligence.sourceNote: Figures are illustrative industry estimates / public-filing averages for demo use. Verify before live bid submission.
proposalManagerCompetitiveIntelligence.liveHint: Selecting a competitor refreshes datasheet metrics and differentiators live from the JUNO API (OpenAI). Curated samples remain as fallback if the call fails.
proposalManagerCompetitiveIntelligence.liveFallback: Using curated sample — live refresh unavailable
proposalManagerCompetitiveIntelligence.selectMax: You can compare up to {{max}} competitors at a time.
proposalManagerCompetitiveIntelligence.datasheetHint: Toggle which financial and operating metrics appear as comparison columns.
proposalManagerCompetitiveIntelligence.emptyHint: Choose peers from the list to build a side-by-side datasheet comparison and differentiator view.

proposalManagerCompanyIntelligence.title: Company Intelligence
proposalManagerCompanyIntelligence.autoPushLabel: Automatically push company data & charts to Pricing and Workspace when I load a company
proposalManagerCompanyIntelligence.syncedNotice: Synced to Proposal Manager forms (Pricing · Workspace).
proposalManagerCompanyIntelligence.remoteLookupDisclaimer: This profile was built from live English Wikipedia excerpts plus AI structuring, not from the offline 1,152-company dataset. Financial charts appear only when figures were explicitly stated in those sources; verify all facts before submitting an RFP.
proposalManagerCompanyIntelligence.searchInListPlaceholder: Search in list (ticker, name, region, sector)
proposalManagerCompanyIntelligence.noCompaniesFound: No companies found for this filter/search.
proposalManagerCompanyIntelligence.errorEnterCompanyOrTicker: Enter a company name or ticker symbol.
proposalManagerCompanyIntelligence.errorNoSampleData: No sample data for "{{query}}". Pick from the list or try a known ticker (e.g. AAPL, MSFT).

aiBriefing.title: AI briefing
aiBriefing.subtitle: Summary grounded in the figures below, via JUNO backend (POST /ask-with-context). Revenue, net income, and assets charts use the same sample data.
aiBriefing.genericError: Could not generate AI briefing. Is juno-backend running on port 3000 with OPENAI_API_KEY set?
aiBriefing.prompt: The user searched for "{{query}}". Using ONLY the structured company data in the document, write a concise briefing for a proposal manager: (1) financial scale and trajectory, (2) notable strengths or risks visible in the numbers, (3) one or two proposal-relevant angles (partnership, competitive, or service positioning). Cite specific reporting periods and figures when stating numbers. If the data does not support a point, say so.

charts.title: Financial trends
charts.subtitle: Revenue and net income by reporting period
charts.assetsSubtitle: Same sample dataset as the metrics above

proposalManagerContentHub.title: Content Hub
proposalManagerContentHub.description: Q&A library with tags. Filter by tag or add Q&As manually. Upload documents in Workspace to extract Q&As automatically.
proposalManagerContentHub.linkedIssuerSuffix: — push the auto-generated overview into your Q&A library for reuse in the response.
proposalManagerContentHub.noQAsYet: No Q&As yet. Add manually or upload documents in Workspace to extract Q&As.

aiAssistant.heading: Ask AI
aiAssistant.hint: Ask about your proposal. Optionally choose a file (.txt, .pdf, .docx); text is extracted on the server and used to answer your question.
aiAssistant.extractError: Could not read enough text from this file. Try a text-based PDF, Word (.docx), or plain .txt file. Scanned PDFs may take a moment to process.
aiAssistant.slideDeckHint: Turn this answer into a branded PowerPoint (.pptx) with speaker notes.
aiAssistant.exportHint: Export this answer as a Word document (.docx) or a branded PowerPoint deck (.pptx).

companyProfileGenerator.heading: Company Profile Generator
companyProfileGenerator.hint: Enter a company name, website, and/or paste a short description. JUNO backend generates structured RFP-ready text.
companyProfileGenerator.pastedContentPlaceholder: Paste an About page, capability statement, or notes…
companyProfileGenerator.validationHint: Enter at least a company name, a website URL, or pasted text.

proposalManagerTechnicalSolutioning.subtitle: Ingest your prior architecture diagrams, system designs, and product solutions — then generate a grounded technical solution blueprint mapped to this RFP's requirements with traceability, confidence scores, and SME flags.
proposalManagerTechnicalSolutioning.libraryHint: Select assets to ground the AI design. Demo assets are pre-loaded — upload your own architecture docs, HLD/LLD, integration specs, or product solution briefs.
proposalManagerTechnicalSolutioning.indexedAt: {{count}} reusable components extracted from your library
proposalManagerTechnicalSolutioning.noPatternsYet: Select references and click Index patterns to build your reusable solution catalog.
